titleEn: The Reno Stars Renovation Workflow: From First Consultation to Final Walk-Through in Greater Vancouver
titleZh: 雷諾之星裝修流程：從首次諮詢到溫哥華地區最終驗收
contentEn:
Every home renovation starts with a question that has no easy answer: what actually happens between "I want to renovate" and "the keys are handed back"? For Greater Vancouver homeowners working with Reno Stars, the process follows five distinct stages that typically span eight to twenty-four weeks depending on scope. Here is how a project moves from first phone call to final walk-through.

Stage 1 — Free In-Home Consultation

The process begins with a no-obligation, no-cost in-home consultation. A Reno Stars project consultant visits the home, takes measurements, discusses the homeowner's vision, and identifies structural or code constraints that may affect the plan. This visit typically runs sixty to ninety minutes and covers the scope in outline only — not a final quote. At this stage, homeowners should prepare: a list of must-haves versus nice-to-haves, any inspiration photos collected from Houzz, Pinterest, or Instagram, and awareness of which rooms will be out of commission during work.

Planning a kitchen, bathroom, whole-home or commercial renovation? Get a free, no-obligation quote from Reno Stars.

Stage 2 — Detailed Proposal and Design

After the consultation, Reno Stars produces a detailed scope document and preliminary pricing. For projects involving structural changes — removing a load-bearing wall, relocating plumbing, or rewiring a panel — this stage includes working with a licensed structural engineer or the project's engineering partner. Homeowners receive a line-by-line breakdown of costs: demolition, materials, labour, permits, and a contingency allowance, typically five to ten percent for unforeseen conditions once walls are opened.

Stage 3 — Permit Application and Pre-Construction Setup

Most interior renovations in Greater Vancouver require a building permit from the relevant municipality: City of Vancouver, City of Surrey, City of Richmond, City of Burnaby, City of Coquitlam, City of Delta, City of North Vancouver, City of New Westminster, City of Port Coquitlam, City of Port Moody, City of Maple Ridge, or City of Langley. Reno Stars manages this application on the homeowner's behalf. Permit timelines vary: City of Vancouver typically runs four to eight weeks for standard residential alterations; suburban municipalities often move in two to four weeks. Projects with structural engineering or heritage considerations take longer.

Stage 4 — Active Construction

Once permits are issued and materials are confirmed with suppliers, construction begins. Reno Stars assigns a dedicated site supervisor who conducts weekly site visits and communicates progress through a shared WhatsApp or email group that includes the homeowner. Typical milestone schedule for a whole-home renovation:

  • Week 1–2: Demolition and disposal
  • Week 2–4: Rough-in: framing, electrical, plumbing, HVAC
  • Week 4–6: Insulation, vapour barrier, drywall preparation
  • Week 6–10: Finishing: tiling, cabinet installation, flooring, paint
  • Week 10–12: Fixtures, trim, final electrical and plumbing connections
  • Week 12+: Final inspection and punch list

Bathroom-only renovations typically complete in four to eight weeks. Kitchen renovations run six to twelve weeks. Whole-home renovations in older heritage homes in Vancouver proper can extend to twenty-plus weeks depending on scope and permit complexity.

Stage 5 — Final Walk-Through and Project Handover

Before keys are returned, Reno Stars conducts a formal walk-through with the homeowner. All punch-list items are reviewed, fixtures are tested, and municipal final inspections are confirmed. The home is left broom-clean. Any remaining small items are documented with a committed completion date. Reno Stars provides a project photo album and warranty documentation at this stage. All work is backed by Reno Stars' labour warranty.

How Long Does a Whole-Home Renovation Take in Vancouver?

Based on actual Reno Stars projects completed in Greater Vancouver, a whole-home renovation involving kitchen, two bathrooms, flooring, and exterior siding on a detached home typically requires twelve to eighteen weeks of active construction after permit issuance. Condo renovations run shorter at eight to fourteen weeks because strata approval timelines are generally faster than municipal building permits. Heritage home renovations — which require heritage designation review in Vancouver and New Westminster — add four to eight weeks to permit timelines alone.

How to Prepare for a Renovation

Homeowners who prepare before the first consultation save time and reduce change orders. Clear the rooms being renovated of furniture and personal items. Confirm with your building management or strata whether there are noise and work-hours bylaws. Notify neighbours for exterior work. Arrange temporary kitchen setup if the main kitchen is out of service — Reno Stars can provide a list of recommended temporary cooking and washing setups used by past clients. Book any required moving or storage containers early; Vancouver container rental companies book out two to three weeks in advance during peak renovation season from April through October.

Planning a kitchen, bathroom, whole-home or commercial renovation? Get a free, no-obligation quote from Reno Stars.

Frequently Asked Questions

Does Reno Stars handle all permit applications?

Yes. Reno Stars prepares and submits the building permit application to the relevant municipality on the homeowner's behalf. The homeowner is responsible for any associated municipal permit fees, which are passed through at cost and typically range from $500 to $3,000 depending on project valuation and municipality.

What happens if structural issues are found during demolition?

If opening walls reveals unexpected conditions — rotted framing, outdated wiring, or non-compliant plumbing — Reno Stars documents the finding with photos and a revised scope. The homeowner approves any increase before work continues. This is why a contingency allowance in the proposal exists: it is not a buffer the contractor keeps, it is a budget set aside for conditions that cannot be seen before demolition.

How does Reno Stars communicate during active construction?

Every active Reno Stars project has a dedicated site supervisor and a shared communication group (WhatsApp or email) that includes the homeowner. Weekly written progress updates summarise completed work, scheduled next steps, and any items requiring homeowner decisions. Response time during business hours is within four hours.

Are Reno Stars projects covered by warranty?

Yes. Reno Stars provides a written labour warranty on all completed work. Materials are covered by manufacturer warranties where applicable. Warranty documentation is provided at the final walk-through and registered with the contractor's office.

每個家居裝修項目都始於一個沒有簡單答案的問題：「從『我想裝修』到『交還鑰匙』之間究竟發生了什麼？」對於與雷諾之星合作的溫哥華地區業主來說，整個流程分為五個階段，通常需要八到二十四週，具體取決於工程範圍。以下是項目如何從首次電話諮詢順利過渡到最終驗收的完整流程。

第一階段——免費上門諮詢

流程始於一次無義務、免費的上門諮詢。雷諾之星項目顧問會到訪住宅，進行測量，討論業主的需求，並識別可能影響規劃的結構或法規限制。這次訪問通常持續六十至九十分鐘，僅涵蓋工程範圍的概況，而非最終報價。在此階段，業主應做好準備：列出必備項目與理想項目，收集任何來自Houzz、Pinterest或Instagram的靈感照片，並了解施工期間哪些空間將無法使用。

規劃廚房、浴室、全屋或商業裝修？立即獲取雷諾之星的免費、無義務報價。

第二階段——詳細方案與設計

諮詢結束後，雷諾之星提供詳細的工程範圍文件和初步報價。對於涉及結構變更的項目——例如拆除承重牆、搬遷管道或重新布線配電箱——此階段包括與持牌結構工程師或項目工程合作夥伴協調。業主將收到逐項成本細分：拆遷、材料、人工、許可證費用，以及應急儲備金，通常為工程造價的百分之五至十，以應對牆體開鑿後可能發現的意外情況。

第三階段——許可證申請與施工前準備

溫哥華大都會區的大多數室內裝修項目需要向相關市政當局申請建築許可證：包括溫哥華市、薩里市、列治文市、本拿比市、高貴林市、三角洲市、北溫哥華市、新西敏市、高貴林港市、穆迪港市、楓樹嶺市或蘭里市等。雷諾之星代表業主提交此申請。許可證審批時間各不相同：溫哥華市對於標準住宅改建項目通常需要四至八週；郊區市政當局的審批時間通常為兩至四週。涉及結構工程或文化遺產考量的項目需要更長的時間。

第四階段——積極施工

一旦許可證簽發並確認材料供應到位，施工即開始。雷諾之星為每個項目指派專屬工地督導員，每週進行實地巡查，並通過共用的WhatsApp或電子郵件群組與業主溝通進度。全屋裝修項目的典型里程碑時間表如下：

  • 第1–2週：拆除與廢棄物清運
  • 第2–4週：隱蔽工程：水電管線、框架結構
  • 第4–6週：隔熱、蒸氣 barrier、石膏板基層
  • 第6–10週：飾面工程：瓷磚、櫥櫃安裝、地板、牆面漆
  • 第10–12週：五金器具、線腳、機電最終連接
  • 第12週起：最終驗收與整改清單

僅浴室裝修通常在四至八週內完成。廚房裝修需要六至十二週。溫哥華市內老舊文化遺產住宅的全屋裝修由於需要遺產認定審查，可能延長至二十週以上。

第五階段——最終驗收與項目移交

在歸還鑰匙之前，雷諾之星會與業主進行正式的現場驗收。所有整改項目均需逐一核查，測試所有五金器具，並確認市政最終檢查已完成。交付時室內保持清潔。任何剩餘的小項目均以書面承諾完成日期記錄在案。雷諾之星在此階段提供項目實景照片集及保修文件，所有工程均受雷諾之星人工保修保障。

溫哥華全屋裝修通常需要多長時間？

根據雷諾之星在溫哥華地區完成的實際項目數據，涉及廚房、兩間浴室、地板及外牆板的獨立住宅全屋裝修項目，在許可證簽發後通常需要十二至十八週的積極施工。公寓裝修時間較短，為八至十四週，因為共管公寓審批時間通常比市政建築許可證更快。文化遺產住宅裝修——需要在溫哥華和新西敏市進行遺產認定審查——僅許可證審批時間就增加四至八週。

裝修前業主應如何準備？

在首次諮詢前做好準備的業主能節省時間並減少變更訂單帶來的成本。清理將要裝修的房間中的家具和個人物品。與建築管理處或共管公寓理事會確認噪音和工作時間規定。就外牆工程通知鄰居。提前預訂臨時廚房設置所需的移動或儲存集裝箱；溫哥華的集裝箱租賃公司在四月到十月的裝修旺季通常需要提前兩到三週預訂。

規劃廚房、浴室、全屋或商業裝修？立即獲取雷諾之星的免費、無義務報價。

常見問題解答

雷諾之星是否代為處理所有許可證申請？

是的。雷諾之星代表業主準備並向相關市政當局提交建築許可證申請。業主需自行負擔相關市政許可證費用，該費用按成本代收代付，通常在500至3,000加元之間，具體取決於項目造價及市政當局標準。

如果在拆除期間發現結構問題會怎麼樣？

如果在開牆後發現意外情況——如框架腐爛、布線過時或管道不合規——雷諾之星會以照片記錄發現並提供修訂工程範圍。在繼續施工前需獲得業主批准。這正是報價中包含應急儲備金的原因：這不是承包商保留的緩衝金，而是為應對拆除前無法預見的情況而設置的預留預算。

雷諾之星在積極施工期間如何溝通？

每個正在進行中的雷諾之星項目都有專屬工地督導員和共用的溝通群組（WhatsApp或電子郵件），業主亦在其中。每週提供書面進度更新，概述已完成工作、預定後續步驟及任何需要業主決策的事項。工作時間內的響應時間通常在四小時以內。

雷諾之星的項目是否提供保修？

是的。雷諾之星對所有完成的工程提供書面人工保修。如適用，材料受製造商保修保障。保修文件在最終驗收時提供，並在承包商辦事處登記備案。
excerptEn: A plain-language guide to how Reno Stars runs a renovation project in Greater Vancouver — five stages from first consultation to final walk-through, with real timelines and honest answers.
